notes: Volumetric (Sieverts) H2 uptake at 40 C (313.15 K), up to 45 bar, on pristine DMHCS (carbon spheres, 0 wt% TGA residue) and on Pd-decorated samples. Pristine DMHCS (0.17 wt% at 45 bar, SBET 1378 m2/g) meets I2 to I4 on its own. Pd@C_24 (30 wt% Pd) and Pd@C_72 (34 wt% Pd) are majority carbon; 2-Pd@C_24 (59 wt% Pd) and 3-Pd@C_24 (75 wt% Pd) are majority Pd by mass and are not carbon sorbents under section 3. The paper cites its own earlier work on Pd-decorated OMHCS and DMHCS [33,34] but does not state that the H2 uptake values reported here were published before, so duplicate_data is not applied. Not a review; is_retracted is false; text is in English.
